decisions.reason: The copper-coated glass substrates (ACT) are a young flagship line close to the firm's core glass competence and fit the growing glass-core packaging market, so there is no clear shortfall against aspirations, and the slack of a growing, investing firm lets it carry the line while results mature.

VLIS was launched only in 2024 as a flagship technology for through-glass vias and presented on its own page, which fits the firm's push into higher-value semiconductor applications; it is too early for any performance gap to trigger problemistic search or withdrawal.
